## Question and goal

What are you trying to do, and where are you stuck?

## What you checked

Link the guide or issue you read and describe what you tried.

## Environment and evidence

Include the app URL/base path, browser/OS, or source commit and exact development command. Redact logs/screenshots and use generated media. Follow [support guidance](https://github.com/WilsonLe/LocalCut/blob/main/SUPPORT.md); do not post credentials, callbacks, private backups or security exploit details.
